meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 切换 ultrawork 模式以遵循特定指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 Codex 上开发时需要启用 ultrawork 模式
copy.tagline_en: Switch to ultrawork mode to follow specific instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enable ultrawork mode on Codex

howto.what: 进入该模式后，Claude 先显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，然后按严格流程办事：先建立目标并用记事本跟踪，先写失败测试再实现，再实际运行/调用真实界面验证，并留下证据；不会只给代码或测试通过就算完成。
howto.when: 当你对 Claude 说的话里包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式帮我修复这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会先声明模式，再按严格流程验证修复。

say.text: 进入 ulw 模式，完成这个新功能。
say.note: 它会先写失败测试再实现，并实际运行验证。

say.text: 请用 ultrawork 方式实现这个需求，并给出验证证据。
say.note: 它会在记事本记录步骤并做真实表面验证。

howto.what_en: In this mode, Claude first prints "ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!" and then follows a strict process: set a goal, track it in a notepad, write failing tests first, implement, run real-surface verification, and capture evidence — not just code or a green test suite.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your prompt contains "ultrawork" or "ulw".

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix this bug.
say_en.note: Claude announces the mode and verifies the fix rigorously.

say_en.text: Enter ulw mode and complete this new feature.
say_en.note: It writes failing tests first, implements, and runs real checks.

say_en.text: Implement this in ultrawork style and show verification evidence.
say_en.note: It tracks steps in a notepad and does real-surface verification.
